'''Research Division''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It dealt with new and different products, working in tandem with the design and marketing teams of various sponsor companies. The majority of projects worked on by the Research Division were secret projects for the Authority itself, including experimental military equipment.<ref name="HSCS" />
